# EnsembleAveragedSolution

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A solution obtained by averaging over many random instances of the problem, yielding typical-case performance rather than worst-case. Enables robust design of neuromorphic and interconnect systems that perform well on average across varying topologies.
